notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have just released a Hotfix (v1.1.5) addressing a few issues that slipped into yesterday’s patch.


🛠 Hotfix Details
The Settings menu in the main menu is once again accessible via controller.

The Delete Save button in the main menu settings is now properly visible.

NPC nameplates now correctly rotate toward the camera.

The Save button in the pause menu is now properly visible.



These issues were identified while working on the Nintendo Switch version of Cosmic Arcade Tycoon and have now been resolved. Everything should function as intended once more. Make sure to contact me if you encounter any bugs or other issues! 



Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4 – Lively Aliens & Better Balance!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Version 1.1.4 is here! 🚀🛸 This update brings a fresh breeze into the game and adds even more atmosphere to your intergalactic arcade.

🛠 What’s new in this update:

🌍 Automatic Language Selection – The game now starts in the language you’ve set in Steam.

👽 Alien Names – Visitors from across the cosmos now come with random names shown above their heads. Get to know your guests better!

🎨 Colorful Spacesuits – Aliens now appear in random suit colors, making your arcade even more lively and diverse.

💰 Object Cost Balancing – Several object prices have been adjusted to make the experience fairer and more strategic.

🐛 Other Small Improvements – For an overall smoother gameplay experience.

🎯 Why should you try this update?
Your guests now feel more individual and alive – and thanks to the improved language selection and object balancing, running your arcade is more accessible and exciting than ever!

Thanks for your feedback and support – I’m already working on more surprises, so stay tuned! 🌠

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Just a quick patch this time to smooth out a couple of pesky issues some of you reported. Thanks again for all your helpful feedback!

🔧 What’s Fixed in This Update:

🪴 Plant Removal Bug – You can now properly remove plants again.

🚶 Door Collision Fix – Resolved a blocking issue where players could get stuck trying to move through certain doors.

🧹 Minor Cleanup – A few behind-the-scenes tweaks to keep things running cleanly.

💡 Why Check It Out?
If you ran into problems while decorating or navigating your arcade, this patch should help make things smoother. These fixes are small but help keep the experience polished.

Thanks again for playing and reporting bugs — more updates coming soon!

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Update 1.1 - Galactic Palette
notes.notes:
Exciting news — Update 1.1: The Galactic Palette Update has arrived! 🌌🎨 This update brings a brand-new object recoloring system, new sci-fi objects, and key improvements to make your experience even better.

[previewyoutube=2SWD8RR8g6A;full][/previewyoutube]Hey everyone!

🛠 What’s New in This Update:

🎨 Recolor System – Customize your arcade like never before! Certain objects can now be recolored, giving you more freedom to create unique and vibrant designs.

🪐 New Cosmic Unlocks – Expand your creativity with a fresh selection of sci-fi objects, perfect for building the ultimate intergalactic experience.

🏆 New Achievements – Put your skills to the test with a set of brand-new achievements! Can you unlock them all?

⚙️ System Readjustments – No more inviting visitors manually! Once they spawn in, they’ll automatically find their way to your arcade, making management smoother than ever.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Performance Boosts – Further optimizations using LOD and material instancing should significantly improve performance! 🚀

🎯 Why Check It Out?
If you’ve been waiting for more ways to personalize and optimize your arcade, this update is for you! With new customization tools, achievements, and sci-fi objects, your world is about to look better than ever.

Thank you for your support—more exciting features are on the way, so stay tuned! 🌠

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Localization Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Exciting news, Cosmic Arcade Tycoon now supports even more languages! 🌎 We’ve been working hard to bring the game to a wider audience, and with this update, we’re adding Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese to the mix!

🛠 What’s New in This Update:

🌐 New Language Support – Play the game in your preferred language! Menus, tooltips and in-game text have been fully localized.

🔄 UI Adjustments – Tweaked layouts to ensure text fits properly across different languages.

🎯 Why Check It Out?
If you’ve been waiting to experience Cosmic Arcade Tycoon in your native language, now’s the time! This update ensures more players can enjoy the game without language barriers.

Thank you for your continued support! More exciting features and improvements are on the way, stay tuned! 🚀

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for all your feedback! I’ve been working hard to make Cosmic Arcade Tycoon smoother and more immersive. This patch brings performance improvements, NPC adjustments, and lighting tweaks to enhance your arcade experience.

🛠 What’s New in This Update:

🎭 NPC Behavior Fixes – Visitors now move more efficiently and interact better with objects, reducing awkward repositioning issues, especially in crowded arcades.

🚀 Performance Optimizations – Improved Level of Detail (LOD) handling for better frame rates and smoother gameplay.

💡 Lighting Enhancements – Adjusted lights and effects for a more polished arcade atmosphere. Prop lights now disable when far away, reducing rendering costs.

🛠 Script Refinements – Various backend improvements to boost stability and responsiveness.

🎯 Why Check It Out?
If you’ve noticed NPC glitches or performance drops, this update should make your arcade-building smoother and more enjoyable! It also improves compatibility for lower-spec devices, allowing more players to join the fun.

A huge thank you to our amazing players for your continued support! More updates and features are coming soon, I’ll be sharing details about the future tomorrow! Stay tuned! 🚀

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This patch fixes Steam Achievements not unlocking and introduces a retroactive achievement unlock system, simply open the Unlock screen ingame to claim any you’ve earned.

If you’ve been missing achievements, this update should set things right. Thank you for your patience and support. Keep building your ultimate cosmic arcade! 🌌🎮

Let me know if you’d like any tweaks! 🚀

notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Thank you for the valuable feedback I have been getting! A few key issues have been addressed in this patch, bringing several improvements to enhance your Cosmic Arcade Tycoon experience.

🎮 What’s New in This Update:

👾 Visitor Behavior Fixes – Visitors now behave correctly when bikes or racing machines are removed from under them, or if they get caught between objects. Expect a smoother experience all around!

🌌 Post-Processing Tweaks – The vignette and bloom effects have been reduced to fix some visual issues. The game’s visuals should now feel more balanced and refined.

🚀 Pop-In/Out Optimization – Object and environment spawning has been optimized, reducing pop-in issues. Transitions are now smoother, making your arcade feel even more immersive.

📢 Why Check It Out:

If any of the issues mentioned have affected gameplay, this update should make things run more smoothly. These changes aim to make managing your cosmic arcade even more enjoyable and seamless!

A big thank you to everyone for the support on the first day! It’s truly appreciated, and the feedback keeps making Cosmic Arcade Tycoon better. Can’t wait to see where the journey goes next!
